memories.text: Gumroad product plan: Option A (Freelance Client Command Center, Notion template, 7-27) is primary — starting Phase 3 architecture now. Option B (Stop the Scope Creep mini-course, 7-97) is queued for later. Option C (Client Command System bundle, 7-197) follows Option B. Audience: freelance designers & developers. Revenue target: 00-1k/month. Pain points validated: scope creep, no source of truth, client comms overhead, no repeatable workflow. Gate 1 cleared 4/5.

Phase 3 architecture complete: Freelance Client Command Center — Notion template at 7/7. Architecture doc at gumroad-product/product-architecture-optionA.md. Covers 5 sections: Kickoff Pack, Scope Tracker, Client Status Hub, Revision Counter, Communication Log. Ready for Phase 4 build. Gate 3 approval pending from user.

Created design-md skill at Skills/design-md/ with scaffold and fetch-brand scripts for Google's DESIGN.md spec. Rule created to auto-consult DESIGN.md before all frontend code generation.

Character: Aric, a stoic knight, and Lira, a fiery sorceress. Story arc: they are forced to guard a magical artifact together, start as enemies, gradually fall in love, culminating in a powerful united spell.

User asked for a 30-second cinematic teaser trailer generated from a storyboard image, keeping the cards as close to the original storyboard as possible, with sound effects but no music. I generated six 5-second clips with timestamp overlays and stitched them into a final MP4 at /home/workspace/Images/deus_vult_trailer/deus_vult_teaser_trailer.mp4.
